question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

LARGE : NDTJG :: APPLES : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ae5efc115000d38a9442de7b29614b0d0cdf1ada7f25abd4e79483f28121110.png] 

 
• **First letter of word is increased by +2.**
 
• **Second letter of word is increased by +3.**
 
• **This above logic is repeated for other alphabets alternatively.**
